programme.title: 3ABN Sabbath School Panel
programme.desc: Explore the New Testament gift of prophecy and discover how the Holy Spirit works through diverse ministries while preserving one consistent message centered on Jesus Christ. This lesson examines the role of prophets in the early church, how prophets differed from apostles, and how spiritual gifts functioned under the same divine Source. See the continuity between Old and New Testament prophecy, learn how the Spirit empowers God’s messengers, and consider biblical warnings about false prophets. Strengthen your understanding of prophecy, inspiration, spiritual gifts, and Christ-centered truth for believers today worldwide.

programme.title: 3ABN Worship Hour
programme.sub-title: Walking in the Light: Living Your New Identity In
programme.desc: In this 3ABN production, Shelley Quinn presents a powerful Bible message on walking in the light, discovering your identity in Christ, and living as a child of God. What changes when Jesus delivers us from the kingdom of darkness? Through Ephesians, Colossians, and 1 John, discover how salvation transforms not only our identity but also our daily Christian walk. Learn how the Holy Spirit develops Christlike character, empowers obedience, exposes hidden sin, and leads believers into spiritual growth. Walking in the light is not about perfection—it is about surrendering daily to Jesus and allowing His character to shine through your life.

programme.title: The Ultimate Encounter
programme.desc: In this transformative episode, we delve into the life-changing power of forgiveness and how it shapes our spiritual journey. Discover how the most influential person in your life might be the one you struggle to forgive. Through the teachings of Christ, we learn that forgiveness is not just a gift we offer others but a personal freedom we embrace ourselves. Explore the reciprocal nature of forgiveness, its divine mandate, and the evidence of Christ’s presence when we choose to forgive. As we journey from forgiveness to reconciliation, this episode highlights the importance of mending relationships and living in peace.

programme.title: The Incredible Journey
programme.desc:
From Federation in 1901, Australia’s military story has been written on foreign battlefields: the Boer War, two world wars, Korea, Vietnam, the Gulf, Afghanistan, and Iraq. But in 1932, the only military campaign ever fought on Australian soil unfolded in the wheat belt of Campion, Western Australia.
While the Great Depression crushed farmers, some 20,000 emus descended on their crops. Powerful, flightless, and contemptuous of fences, the birds systematically destroyed livelihoods. Desperate, the government deployed soldiers with machine guns against an enemy that refused to fight like one.
What followed became one of the most peculiar episodes in military history: strategy versus stubborn birds, and an army that discovered its most unconventional opponent. Join Gary Kent as we investigate the Great Emu War, the conflict Australia never expected to fight at home.

programme.desc: Noah explores Dinosaur National Monument in western Colorado. He’ll explore this amazing site, where hundreds of dinosaur skeletons have been found in a mass graveyard. programme.title: Awesome Science
programme.desc: Noah explores The Mammoth Site in Hot Springs, South Dakota. He’ll explore this amazing site, where over one hundred mammoths have been preserved in the sediments in an ancient sinkhole. He’ll find out how genetics can explain where the mammoths came from after the global Flood, why radio carbon dating can only give us accurate dates of a few thousand years, and how they could have reproduced so quickly after coming off the ark. Finally, he’ll explore how the Ice Age, caused by the global Flood, would have come and gone quickly, causing the right conditions to force the mammoths into extinction.

programme.title: Truth for Life
programme.desc: In The True Identity, Dr. Mark Sandoval explains how freedom, love, and stability flow from understanding who we truly are. Humanity’s fallen nature assumes the role of god—self-owned, self-sustaining, and self-defending—while God’s original design identifies us as His children: dependent, secure, and free. This episode shows what it looks like to live that identity in practical relationships, parenting, marriage, loss, injustice, and suffering. Using vivid illustrations, Dr. Sandoval demonstrates how having God as our only source frees us from manipulation, fear, control, and taking life personally. He contrasts stewardship with ownership, revealing why loss only devastates when we believe something belonged to us. The message also reframes suffering as a “talent” God uses to extend comfort and redemption to others. By grounding identity in God’s character and love, this presentation offers a pathway to contentment, resilience, and unselfish love that remains steady regardless of circumstances.

Follow the twists and turns of the dramatic life accounts of Isaac, Jacob, and Joseph, and see how God’s gracious intervention helped them endure hardships, and brought them into covenant relationship with Him so that they could inherit His blessings. The lives of the patriarchs reverberate with lessons for our generation.

programme.title: Grace & Truth with Duane Sheriff
programme.desc: Healing is not something we earn or deserve. It is a gift of grace, received through faith in what Jesus has already provided. In The God Who Heals, Duane Sheriff teaches how God’s nature, love, mercy, and Word reveal His desire to heal. From the Passover and the promises of God to the life and ministry of Jesus and His finished work on the cross, Scripture reveals healing as part of God’s redemptive provision. Discover biblical ways to receive and minister healing through prayer, communion, laying on of hands, anointing with oil, and gifts of the Spirit.
